This is aligned with Section 2(41) and other provisions of the Companies Act, 2013. Due to the aforesaid change in financial year, the audited financial results shall be for a period of 15 months commencing from 1st January 2023 to 31st March 2024. The Company has been communicating the above fact in all our previous communication to the stock exchanges with regard to results.
